title: Ice skating is learned in small, clear steps, one level at a time
alt: A smooth outdoor rink at dusk, a small ice resurfacer at the far end, bare trees behind the boards.

posts.facebook:
Fancy gliding around the ice rink this winter?

Skating is learned in small, clear steps, which is why lessons are set out in levels. In Britain, Skate UK, the national learn-to-skate program, is taught at more than 40 rinks. In the US, Learn to Skate USA has a six-level course for adults.

Many adult beginners' courses include skate rental. Just bring gloves, thin socks and warm layers.

Who would you take to the rink with you?

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/learn-to-ice-skate/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
